prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering of a 20 mm robot fingertip tactile cartridge in operating moment, sectioned close-up isometric side view slightly exploded vertically to reveal stack. On a plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product lighting. Bottom: small dark rigid finger holder block cut off cleanly at backdrop, with stiff light-grey rigid mounting core bolted to it. Above core: green printed circuit readout board with tiny chips, then thin taxel electrode board, then dense array of tiny translucent silicone pillars about 1-2 mm tall, then thin translucent vibration film, then matte grey ridged silicone touch skin cap about fingertip-nail size covering top. An adult human index fingertip presses the center of the ridged skin, denting it visibly, central pillars compressed more than outer pillars, showing scale that whole device is about 20 mm across. A thin flat flexible orange-brown tail cable exits the rear of the boards and loops back. Fixed parts rigid core, boards, holder stay still; moving parts skin, film and pillars compress under press. Show clean legible callouts on small light tags in empty space with thin leader lines to each focus part: Ridged Touch Skin, Vibration Sensing Film, Soft Pillar Array, Taxel Electrode Board, Rigid Mounting Core, Flexible Rear Tail, and no other text, margins or scale bars. Real materials, sharp focus, mechanism readable.
must_not: room interiors or landscapes or sky
hand-drawn sketch style or diagram colors or arrows
generic large blocks disconnected from mechanism

visual_plan.view: close-up isometric side section, slightly vertically separated to expose layers, eye-level with stack
visual_plan.spatial_layout: vertical stack from bottom to top: holder plate, screw heads below, rigid core, readout board with tail exiting right-rear, electrode board, pillar array gap, vibration film, ridged skin cap; human fingertip above center touching skin; tail looping to side; light-grey void around for callout tags
visual_plan.operating_moment: adult fingertip pressing center of ridged skin under grip load, skin and film deflecting down, central soft pillars visibly shortened to measure normal and shear, film sensing slip vibration, signals flowing to rear tail
visual_plan.transfer_path: load path outer skin into film into pillar array into electrode board into rigid core into holder; sensing path pillar compression to capacitance plus film charge to readout to flexible tail bus to grasp controller
visual_plan.interactions: human fingertip presses ridged skin; skin presses vibration film; film presses pillar tops; pillars compress down onto electrode board; boards are carried by rigid core; core clamped by screws to holder; electrode signals and film signals route to readout then to rear tail
avoid: landscape or room or furniture context
sketch colors, circles, line hatching as materials
hidden internals, all focus layers must be visible in section
extra text, numbers, scale bars outside callout tags

focus_parts.purpose: protects stack and spreads contact for grip friction
senses high-frequency slip vibration and texture
compressible spring and sensing gap for static force
holds capacitive taxel electrodes for static force
carries sensing stack and bolts to finger holder
carries four-wire bus out rear of finger
